saved_concepts.title: Chemiosmotic Coupling & Proton-Motive Force
saved_concepts.query: Explain Chemiosmotic Hypothesis and ATP Synthase Proton Gradient
saved_concepts.explanation: The chemiosmotic hypothesis describes how electrochemical proton gradients across the inner mitochondrial membrane drive ATP synthesis via ATP synthase (F0-F1 rotor complex).

quiz.question: What happens to ATP synthesis if the inner membrane becomes permeable to protons?
options: Proton gradient dissipates as heat; ATP synthesis halts
ATP synthase reverses direction and pumps protons back
quiz.explanation: Uncouplers like DNP collapse the proton gradient, converting potential energy into heat.

quick_notes.title: Amdahl's Law Formula
quick_notes.content: Speedup = 1 / ((1 - P) + (P / S)), where P is parallel fraction and S is speedup of parallel part.
